# FILE-TERMINATION exceptions — scripts/check_file_termination.sh
#
# Every tracked text file ends with exactly one newline. A file listed here does
# not, and the reason must be that its BYTES are not ours to reformat: they are
# generated by a writer whose output would revert the edit, or they are hashed
# and published so a byte change would move a digest other records cite.
#
# Format: <tracked path><TAB><reason>
# Prefer fixing the producer over adding a line here.

# `Prompts::digest` hashes these exact bytes and every benchmark report publishes
# the result as `prompts_digest`, "the versioning anchor in reports". Adding a
# newline would move that anchor and break comparability with every historical
# report, so the corpus version — not a whitespace fix — is where this changes.
# `bench/v1/corpus.json` is digest-bound the same way and happens to conform; if
# it ever stops conforming the same reasoning applies to it.
crates/reasonbraid-adapter/bench/v1/prompts.json	digest-bound corpus bytes published as prompts_digest in every benchmark report
